title: Americans' social activity has steeply declined in the past 30 years
title_zh: 过去30年间，美国人的社交活动急剧减少

paragraphs.en: In recent years, there has been extensive discussion of a social decline in the United States, including a U.S. surgeon general advisory in 2023 that declared American loneliness to be an “epidemic.”
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，关于美国社会衰退的讨论十分广泛，包括美国卫生局长于2023年发布的一份咨询报告，该报告宣告美国的孤独已成一种“流行病”。

paragraphs.en: Various surveys have tracked America’s social decline over the past few decades. Tracking data from the American Time Use Survey shows that Americans are spending more time alone and less time with friends than they were two decades ago. Perhaps most notably, the American Perspectives Survey has found that from 1990 to 2021, the percentage of Americans with five or more close friends dropped by 25 points , from 63% to 38%.
paragraphs.zh: 多项调查追踪了美国过去几十年的社会衰退。 来自《美国人时间使用调查》的追踪数据显示，与二十年前相比，美国人独处的时间变多了，与朋友相处的时间变少了。 或许最值得注意的是，《美国人观点调查》发现，从1990年到2021年，拥有五个或以上亲密朋友的美国人比例下降了25个百分点，从63%降至38%。

sents.en: Various surveys have tracked America’s social decline over the past few decades.
sents.zh: 多项调查追踪了美国过去几十年的社会衰退。

sents.en: Tracking data from the American Time Use Survey shows that Americans are spending more time alone and less time with friends than they were two decades ago.
sents.zh: 来自《美国人时间使用调查》的追踪数据显示，与二十年前相比，美国人独处的时间变多了，与朋友相处的时间变少了。

sents.en: Perhaps most notably, the American Perspectives Survey has found that from 1990 to 2021, the percentage of Americans with five or more close friends dropped by 25 points , from 63% to 38%.
sents.zh: 或许最值得注意的是，《美国人观点调查》发现，从1990年到2021年，拥有五个或以上亲密朋友的美国人比例下降了25个百分点，从63%降至38%。

paragraphs.en: But while extensive public tracking data show general declines in Americans’ socialization, little, if any, public data show what this looks like for the average American — how the day-to-day activities Americans participate in have changed over the past few decades.
paragraphs.zh: 但是，尽管大量的公开追踪数据显示美国人的社交活动总体呈下降趋势，却几乎没有任何公开数据表明普通美国人的情况是怎样的——即美国人日常参与的活动在过去几十年里发生了怎样的变化。

paragraphs.en: In a new survey , Data for Progress surveyed 1,098 U.S. adults and asked them how many times they engaged in various specific social activities in the past 12 months. These questions directly replicate the DDB Needham Life Style surveys, which tracked Americans’ participation in various activities from 1975-1999 and were referenced in Robert Putnam’s 2000 book “Bowling Alone.” In this analysis, Data for Progress’ 2026 data is compared with the DDB Needham Life Style survey from 1995, which is the earliest year in which full data for all comparison questions was available.
paragraphs.zh: 在一项新调查中，Data for Progress 调查了 1,098 名美国成年人，询问他们在过去 12 个月里参与各种特定社交活动的次数。 这些问题直接复刻了 DDB Needham 生活方式调查（DDB Needham Life Style surveys），该调查追踪了 1975 至 1999 年间美国人对各类活动的参与情况，并在罗伯特·帕特南（Robert Putnam）2000 年出版的《独自打保龄》（Bowling Alone）一书中被引用。在本分析中，Data for Progress 的 2026 年数据与 1995 年的 DDB Needham 生活方式调查数据进行对比，因为 1995 年是所有对比问题均有完整数据的最早年份。

sents.en: In a new survey , Data for Progress surveyed 1,098 U.S. adults and asked them how many times they engaged in various specific social activities in the past 12 months.
sents.zh: 在一项新调查中，Data for Progress 调查了 1,098 名美国成年人，询问他们在过去 12 个月里参与各种特定社交活动的次数。

sents.en: These questions directly replicate the DDB Needham Life Style surveys, which tracked Americans’ participation in various activities from 1975-1999 and were referenced in Robert Putnam’s 2000 book “Bowling Alone.” In this analysis, Data for Progress’ 2026 data is compared with the DDB Needham Life Style survey from 1995, which is the earliest year in which full data for all comparison questions was available.
sents.zh: 这些问题直接复刻了 DDB Needham 生活方式调查（DDB Needham Life Style surveys），该调查追踪了 1975 至 1999 年间美国人对各类活动的参与情况，并在罗伯特·帕特南（Robert Putnam）2000 年出版的《独自打保龄》（Bowling Alone）一书中被引用。在本分析中，Data for Progress 的 2026 年数据与 1995 年的 DDB Needham 生活方式调查数据进行对比，因为 1995 年是所有对比问题均有完整数据的最早年份。

paragraphs.en: This survey finds significant, double-digit declines in Americans’ participation in key social activities from 1995 to 2026 .
paragraphs.zh: 这项调查发现，从1995年到2026年，美国人在关键社交活动中的参与度出现了显著的两位数下降。

paragraphs.en: The chart below compares the percentage of Americans who report participating in each tested activity at least one time in the past 12 months, between the 1995 and 2026 surveys. We find that Americans’ participation in various social activities has declined by double-digit margins, including attending a class or seminar (-22), entertaining people in your home (-21), attending church or a place of worship (-20), going on a picnic (-19), going to a club meeting (-19), playing cards (-19), going out to breakfast at a restaurant (-13), and doing volunteer work (-12).
paragraphs.zh: 下图比较了1995年和2026年两次调查中，美国人报告在过去12个月内至少参加过一次各项受测活动的比例。 我们发现，美国人参与各类社交活动的比例出现了两位数的下降，包括参加课程或研讨会（-22）、在家招待客人（-21）、去教堂或宗教场所（-20）、去野餐（-19）、参加俱乐部会议（-19）、打牌（-19）、去餐厅吃早餐（-13）以及做志愿服务（-12）。

sents.en: The chart below compares the percentage of Americans who report participating in each tested activity at least one time in the past 12 months, between the 1995 and 2026 surveys.
sents.zh: 下图比较了1995年和2026年两次调查中，美国人报告在过去12个月内至少参加过一次各项受测活动的比例。

sents.en: We find that Americans’ participation in various social activities has declined by double-digit margins, including attending a class or seminar (-22), entertaining people in your home (-21), attending church or a place of worship (-20), going on a picnic (-19), going to a club meeting (-19), playing cards (-19), going out to breakfast at a restaurant (-13), and doing volunteer work (-12).
sents.zh: 我们发现，美国人参与各类社交活动的比例出现了两位数的下降，包括参加课程或研讨会（-22）、在家招待客人（-21）、去教堂或宗教场所（-20）、去野餐（-19）、参加俱乐部会议（-19）、打牌（-19）、去餐厅吃早餐（-13）以及做志愿服务（-12）。

paragraphs.en: A few activities have seen increased engagement: using the internet (+90), playing a home video game (+22), attending an exercise class (+14), going to a pop or rock concert (+13), and taking an airline trip for personal reasons (+5).
paragraphs.zh: 一些活动的参与度有所上升：使用互联网（+90）、玩家用电子游戏（+22）、参加健身课程（+14）、观看流行或摇滚音乐会（+13），以及因个人原因乘坐航空旅行（+5）。

paragraphs.en: Methodology note: This analysis compares two surveys conducted using different methodologies, including differences in constructing sampling frames, modes, and weighting approaches. The findings below should be read as suggestive of trends, not a precise estimate of change. Please see the “Methodology” section below for more information.
paragraphs.zh: 方法说明：本分析比较了两项采用不同方法开展的调查，包括抽样框构建方式、调查模式以及加权方法的差异。 下文的发现应视为趋势性提示，而非对变化的精确估计。 更多信息请参见下方的“方法论”部分。

paragraphs.en: One of the steepest declines in the survey is for “entertaining people in my home.” While in 1995, 88% of Americans reported entertaining others at home at least once in the past year, this number has declined to 67% in 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 调查中降幅最大的一项是「在家里招待客人」。1995年，88%的美国人表示在过去一年中至少在家招待过他人一次，而到2026年，这一数字已下降至67%。

paragraphs.en: Church attendance has dropped from 74% in 1995 to 54% in 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 教堂出席率已从1995年的74%下降到2026年的54%。

paragraphs.en: The percentage of Americans who report having gone on a picnic in the past year has declined from 58% in 1995 to 39% in 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 报告在过去一年中参加过野餐的美国人比例已从1995年的58%下降至2026年的39%。

paragraphs.en: There has also been a 19-point decline in attendance at club meetings, from 45% in 1995 to 26% in 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 俱乐部会议的出席率也下降了19个百分点，从1995年的45%降至2026年的26%。

paragraphs.en: This analysis adds to existing public data on America’s social decline. Previous reports have found that Americans are spending less time with others and reporting fewer close friends. This new analysis demonstrates that Americans are indeed spending less time in specific social settings, such as restaurants, churches, picnics, parties, bars, and social clubs.
paragraphs.zh: 这项分析补充了有关美国社会衰退的现有公开数据。 此前的报告发现，美国人与他人共处的时间在减少，亲密朋友的数量也在减少。 这项新分析表明，美国人确实花在特定社交场合的时间在减少，例如餐馆、教堂、野餐、聚会、酒吧和社交俱乐部。

sents.en: This analysis adds to existing public data on America’s social decline.
sents.zh: 这项分析补充了有关美国社会衰退的现有公开数据。

sents.en: Previous reports have found that Americans are spending less time with others and reporting fewer close friends.
sents.zh: 此前的报告发现，美国人与他人共处的时间在减少，亲密朋友的数量也在减少。

sents.en: This new analysis demonstrates that Americans are indeed spending less time in specific social settings, such as restaurants, churches, picnics, parties, bars, and social clubs.
sents.zh: 这项新分析表明，美国人确实花在特定社交场合的时间在减少，例如餐馆、教堂、野餐、聚会、酒吧和社交俱乐部。

paragraphs.en: The DDB Needham survey was conducted by Market Facts using a stratified quota sampling procedure that begins with a sampling frame acquired from commercial list brokers. The sample oversamples by demographics such as race, gender, and marital status to oversample lower propensity respondents. Finally, the survey contacted individuals via mail.
paragraphs.zh: DDB Needham 调查由 Market Facts 执行，采用分层配额抽样程序，其抽样框来自商业名录经纪商。 该样本按种族、性别和婚姻状况等人口统计特征进行超额抽样，以超比例抽取低响应倾向的受访者。 最后，该调查通过邮寄方式联系个人。

sents.en: The DDB Needham survey was conducted by Market Facts using a stratified quota sampling procedure that begins with a sampling frame acquired from commercial list brokers.
sents.zh: DDB Needham 调查由 Market Facts 执行，采用分层配额抽样程序，其抽样框来自商业名录经纪商。

sents.en: The sample oversamples by demographics such as race, gender, and marital status to oversample lower propensity respondents.
sents.zh: 该样本按种族、性别和婚姻状况等人口统计特征进行超额抽样，以超比例抽取低响应倾向的受访者。

sents.en: Finally, the survey contacted individuals via mail.
sents.zh: 最后，该调查通过邮寄方式联系个人。

paragraphs.en: In comparison, the Data for Progress adult sample was conducted through web panel suppliers and ensured national representativeness via quota fielding and post-stratification weighting.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，Data for Progress 的成人样本通过网络面板供应商进行，并通过配额抽样和事后分层加权确保全国代表性。

paragraphs.en: There is plenty of research on the compositional differences that exist across survey collection modes, and this is likely to affect these results as questions about religiosity and loneliness tend to demonstrate modal differences and social desirability biases. We understand that these factors are at play in our comparison, but find that the magnitude and consistency in trends across measures is a substantial signal about trends in behaviors nonetheless.
paragraphs.zh: 关于不同调查收集方式之间存在的构成差异已有大量研究，由于有关宗教性和孤独感的问题往往表现出模式差异和社会期许偏差，这些差异很可能影响本研究结果。 我们理解这些因素在我们的比较中发挥作用，但尽管如此，我们仍认为各测量指标在趋势上的幅度和一致性为行为趋势提供了实质性信号。
